detailed_descriptions_html.en:
Your Only Goal: Escape

With friends or on your own, no matter who stands beside you. Behind every door lies a different reality and a new challenge you must overcome. The real question is… can you escape this reality?

Show Your Skills

Reevaluate your abilities and the bond you share with your friends as you solve mechanics and unravel puzzles.

Discover the Mysteries

They say curiosity kills the cat. Luckily, you have friends to sacrifice, just kidding. Keep your eyes open, your team close, and your curiosity under control. Stay in communication, observe, watch your step, and don’t let your curiosity drag you down. Piece the truth together with your team before the darkness tears you apart.

Don’t Trust Your Eyes

Hearing is just as important as seeing. This is an experience that pushes the limits of your mind. Are you witnessing reality, or are the corridors playing tricks on you? Your perception will become your greatest enemy.

Under The Surface

Something isn’t right here. The abnormal events you encounter are proof that this place is toying with you. The moment you realize what you’ve stepped into is the moment your confusion turns into the real nightmare.
